decision: Adopt an explicit 4-tier model: Tier 0 inventory (filesystem/package/config — every repo), Tier 1 heuristic (regex import patterns — inferred/low unless resolved), Tier 2 parser-backed (Python AST + TS/JS today; Swift/Kotlin later), Tier 3 build/runtime (package manager/Gradle/Xcode/LSP/traces — reserved). Confidence rises with tier; the registry tags each extractor with its tier.
rationale: Operator framing 2026-06-09: language-agnostic discovery with honest tiers, not pretend native understanding of every stack.

decision: C0 is a precursor to Plan D, not a UI change. C0 establishes detector + registry + tier-0/1 baseline + tiered coverage; Plan D renders coverage/diff honestly; Plan C+ adds tier-2 per-language parsers incrementally. C0 ships no UI beyond the existing coverage display.
rationale: Operator: add C0 before broad Plan D polish; keep scope to the substrate so each layer stays auditable.

decision: C0 generalizes the existing evidence contract (architecture_contract: source_kind/evidence_basis/confidence/missing_extractor + compute_coverage) rather than replacing it. The Python import crawler + JS import crawler become registered tier-2 extractors; the new tier-0/tier-1 baseline + registry sit under build_view_state alongside them.
rationale: Don't fork the reconciler — C0 is the language-agnostic substrate the Python+JS-centric pieces already partially implement.

decision: Unsupported languages MUST still produce a tier-0 file/config graph with an explicit low-confidence dependency note ('Dependency confidence is low. No <lang> extractor installed.'), never an empty surface and never a confident-looking fake graph. Tier 3 (runtime/build) is declared not_found until a later plan collects it.
rationale: Render-truth generalized to architecture: show what's provable for any repo, be loud about what isn't.

decision: The REPAIRED pre-impl loop ran on this fresh plan and REFUSED the lock with 3 blocking sufficiency findings (high empty-repo tier-0 guarantee; medium project-add wiring not proven together; medium undefined covered-per-evidence-type semantics) generated from a live Codex call — the exact path that crashed pre-fix, now working. Addressed all 3 by tightening F003/F004/F005 acceptance (non-empty tier-0 for empty repo; explicit covered/high parser vs partial/low heuristic semantics; real project-add/build_view_state integration proof). No override used — the gate's findings were legitimate and sharpened the plan.
rationale: First demonstration of the fixed governance loop catching real pre-impl gaps before implementation; addressing > overriding.

decision: Re-locked through the REPAIRED governance loop (PR #32, sufficiency-findings regen fix merged to main f5c6dae). The lock correctly REGENERATED fresh findings instead of reusing the stale committed file ('existing sufficiency findings predate input-fingerprinting — regenerating'), and the prior 3 findings did NOT recur (tightening genuinely addressed empty-repo tier-0, project-add wiring, covered/high semantics). Two NEW legitimate medium findings surfaced: (1) acceptance pins pure/deterministic/bounded for detector+baseline but NOT registry purity/determinism nor detector bounded-traversal on large repos; (2) no explicit truncation/limit-hit signal when a repo exceeds scan caps — a bounded baseline could omit nodes/edges while appearing complete (render-truth gap). Do NOT override — tighten F001/F002 (registry purity+determinism, detector bounded traversal) and F003/F004 (truncation/limit-hit signal in graph + coverage) then re-lock.
rationale: End-to-end validation that the repaired loop regenerates fresh findings on plan edit; the 2 new findings are real and in keeping with C0's own honesty goals.

decision: Tightened acceptance vs the 2 fresh sufficiency findings the repaired loop surfaced (D006). Finding 1 (purity/determinism/bounded): F001 now requires the detector's traversal to be BOUNDED on large repos via a deterministic scan cap with a recorded truncation signal; F002 now requires registry resolution to be PURE + DETERMINISTIC (same profile -> same result, no fs/network). Finding 2 (truncation/limit-hit signal): F003 graph emits an explicit scan_truncated marker when the bounded scan hits its cap (never presents a partial graph as complete); F004 coverage block surfaces that signal so a capped scan never reads as covered; F005 adds an over-cap fixture asserting both. Introduced vocabulary: scan_truncated. No override used — addressing the findings, sharpening the plan.
rationale: Operator-narrowed C0 path: tighten the 2 D006 findings, then re-lock through the repaired gate. Honest render-truth: a bounded scan must announce its own incompleteness.

decision: Second re-lock through the repaired gate: the 2 D006 findings CLEARED (purity/determinism/bounded + truncation signal — D007 tightening worked, confirmed by regeneration not recurring them), and 4 NEW deeper findings surfaced: (1 HIGH integration_gap) F005's 5 fixtures (py/js-ts/swift-kotlin/empty/truncated) not locked to the real build_view_state operator path — can pass via low-level baseline tests; (2 HIGH coverage_gap) detector promises build/test/app-framework/infra/config evidence classes but the coverage block enumerates only filesystem/package_manifest/imports/runtime/adr — detected classes could be invisible or folded into filesystem; (3 MED wiring_gap) plan doesn't protect the render-truth path from filtering out low-confidence/unresolved edges, filesystem/config nodes, or scan_truncated before the operator sees them; (4 MED coverage_gap) deterministic limited/partial/covered rollup rules not locked. The gate is progressively sharpening the plan each round (valuable) but each round costs a paid sufficiency call. PAUSED for operator decision on the next round vs accept-current.
rationale: Honest checkpoint: the repaired loop keeps surfacing real, deeper gaps; addressing > overriding, but the tighten->re-lock cadence is paid and should be operator-paced, not auto-spiraled.

decision: Tightened the plan against all 4 D008 findings, anchored on the coverage-taxonomy design (finding 2, done FIRST per operator direction): the per-evidence-type map is keyed by ONE taxonomy unified with the architecture contract's existing source_kind enum — filesystem (NEW source_kind for tier-0 inventory), code (imports), manifest, build, test, config, infra, doc, adr, runtime; external/unknown stay endpoint classifications outside coverage. Every ProjectProfile detection class (now a CLOSED list on F001) maps deterministically into exactly one evidence_type via a single exported mapping table (languages->code, package_managers->manifest, build_systems->build, test_frameworks->test, app_frameworks->manifest, infra->infra, config->config, docs_adr->doc/adr) with a tested TOTALITY guarantee so no detected class is invisible or folded into filesystem. Around that anchor: (finding 4) pinned the deterministic rollup lattice — limited when no detected language has tier-2 imports coverage (empty repo included); covered only when every detected language is parser-backed AND no detected evidence class is missing_extractor/error AND not scan_truncated; partial otherwise; runtime (tier-3 reserved) and undetected classes report not_found WITHOUT demoting; scan_truncated demotes covered->partial; each rule pinned by a named test case. (finding 1) F005 now drives EVERY fixture (py/js-ts/swift-kotlin/empty/truncated) through the real project-registration + build_view_state operator path with assertions on the final view-state payload; low-level tests supplement but never satisfy. (finding 3) F003/F004 now assert render-truth PASSTHROUGH against the final rendered payload: low-confidence/unresolved tier-1 edges, tier-0 filesystem/config nodes, and scan_truncated survive the render gate unchanged. No override used.
rationale: Operator-paced round 3 (taxonomy-first shape specified 2026-06-09): resolve the model-contract issue deliberately offline, tighten the rest around it, then spend ONE re-lock. Unifying on source_kind avoids a third parallel vocabulary (extractor evidence_kind vs source_kind vs coverage evidence_type) — the exact ambiguity the finding flagged.

decision: Round-4 re-lock (paid call #1 this session, after a free design-gate catch on undeclared detection-class vocabulary): all 4 D008 findings CLEARED (taxonomy/rollup/fixture-path/passthrough tightening confirmed by regeneration), 3 NEW blocking findings + 1 advisory surfaced. Per-finding triage (operator protocol: impl-level defer vs plan-level tighten): ALL three are plan-level pins with a single obvious resolution, no design ambiguity -- (1 HIGH) docs_adr bundled class broke the 1:1 mapping totality -> SPLIT into separate docs->doc and adr->adr detection classes; (2 MED) infra detected+covered but not guaranteed in the tier-0 graph -> F003 now requires detected infra surfaces (Docker/Terraform/K8s/CI) as source_kind=infra nodes reaching the final build_view_state payload, generalized to: every detection class F004 can report covered has a tier-0 node representation when detected; (3 MED) tier-1/tier-2 merge precedence unspecified -> PINNED: parser-backed edges supersede same-source heuristic edges, heuristic only fills gaps, no duplicate low-confidence counterparts for parser-served languages, with a Python/JS no-duplicates test. Advisory (scope creep into Plan D) addressed with an F004 SCOPE GUARD: coverage surfaces through the EXISTING display path only, guard assertion that no new dashboard page/section is introduced. Spending re-lock #2 within the budgeted 2-3 paid calls; if it blocks again with NEW findings, STOP and surface to operator rather than spend a third.
rationale: Findings are converging (narrower + more mechanical each round: model-contract -> mapping arity / node-list omission / dedup rule). All three resolutions are deterministic pins consistent with C0's own honesty goals; deferring them to implementation would leave acceptance ambiguous, which is the exact gap class the gate exists to catch.

decision: Round-5 re-lock (paid call #2 this session) REFUSED with 4 NEW findings after the 3 D010 findings + advisory CLEARED (split docs/adr, infra tier-0 nodes, tier precedence, scope guard all confirmed addressed). New findings: (1 HIGH) per-evidence-type aggregation unpinned when multiple languages fold into the single 'code' key (Python covered + Swift missing -> code = ?); (2 MED) nothing maps to the new 'filesystem' coverage key -- needs an explicit rule that the tier-0 inventory satisfies it; (3 MED) no SINGLE truncation-propagation rule across detector-phase and graph-builder-phase caps; (4 MED) the operator-facing low-confidence NOTE for unextracted languages is only implied via edge confidence, not pinned as a rendered note. STOPPED per the D010 commitment and the operator cadence rule (one considered pass per session was already doubled): all 4 are again plan-level mechanical pins, but the finding count is not shrinking (3->2->4->3->4 across rounds) and a third paid call without operator input would be the slot-machine pattern the operator explicitly forbade. Plan remains status:draft; findings file committed as the honest checkpoint.
rationale: Addressing > overriding still holds, but pacing is the operator's call now. Each round HAS sharpened the contract (this round's findings are aggregation/mapping/propagation pins, not design questions) -- the open question for the operator is whether to spend round 6 or judge the remaining tail impl-level and use the recorded-reason override.

decision: Round-6 tightening (operator-approved final pass, hard rule: one tighten, one re-lock, then stop): pinned all 4 D011 findings as deterministic contract rules in F004 with anchors in F001/F005. (1) MIXED-LANGUAGE AGGREGATION: the single code evidence_type entry is covered only when EVERY detected language is tier-2; not_found when no languages detected; partial in every mixed case (never covered with any language lacking a parser extractor); Python+Swift test pins code=partial with per-language python=covered/swift=missing_extractor. (2) FILESYSTEM SATISFACTION: filesystem is the one evidence_type satisfied structurally by the tier-0 inventory (no detection class maps to it): covered when the bounded scan completed (empty repo included via repo-root node), partial when truncated, never not_found; mapping-totality test excludes filesystem, dedicated test pins empty+truncated cases. (3) TRUNCATION PROPAGATION (ONE RULE): detector cap (F001) and graph cap (F003) set the SAME scan_truncated signal -- either phase's cap demotes filesystem to partial + rollup covered->partial and reaches the final payload; test asserts each phase independently produces the same rendered outcome. (4) LOW-CONFIDENCE NOTE: every detected language without a tier-2 extractor yields a RENDERED note string ('Dependency confidence is low. No <lang> extractor installed.', the D004 wording) as a payload field reaching build_view_state, emitted even with zero heuristic edges; presence asserted for Swift/Kotlin fixture, absence for parser-backed repos. OPERATOR DECISION TREE recorded for the re-lock outcome: clears -> lock and build C0; implementation-detail-only findings -> recorded override with precise reason; another conceptual contract layer -> PAUSE and treat as gate-design problem.
rationale: Operator judged the 4 findings worth pinning (they affect render-truth and operator interpretation) but bounded the loop: this is the final plan-polishing pass regardless of outcome.

decision: Round-6 re-lock (the operator-bounded FINAL pass) REFUSED with 5 NEW findings after all 4 D012 pins CLEARED. Operator decision tree applied: this is branch 3 (another conceptual contract layer) -> PAUSE, no override, treat as gate-design problem. Classification of the 5: (1 HIGH, contract layer) tier-1 'common languages' set unenumerated -- Swift/Kotlin could pass with filesystem-only nodes and no weak dependency baseline; (2 MED, contract layer) satisfaction rules pinned for overall/code/filesystem/runtime but NOT for the other 7 evidence types (manifest/build/test/config/infra/doc/adr); (3 MED, parity pin) F003 lacks the no-network/no-mutation purity clause F001/F002 carry; (4 MED, editorial defect in acceptance wording) F005 empty_repo sentence conflates mutually exclusive fixture cases (empty repo cannot assert Python/JS covered); (5 MED, guard pin) scope guard covers no-new-UI but not the no-new-parser-extractors (C+) non-goal. GATE-DESIGN DIAGNOSIS: across 6 rounds (findings 3->2->4->3->4->5) the gate cleared 100% of each round's findings and always found a fresh layer -- a contract-heavy plan exposes an effectively unbounded matrix of pinnable cells (statuses x evidence-types x phases x fixtures), and the pre-impl sufficiency gate has NO convergence policy, unlike the implementation volley loop which got Design B strictly-shrinking-count convergence breakers in plan 2026-05-30-002. The sufficiency gate needs an analogous policy (e.g. after N rounds of full-clearance with only <=medium pin-class findings, downgrade to advisory / force operator disposition), and/or auditor-side classification of findings as plan-level vs impl-level. Plan stays draft at this checkpoint; the 5 findings are committed and are genuinely useful input for the eventual lock, whichever path the operator picks.
rationale: Hard rule honored: one tighten pass, one re-lock, stop. The findings are not wrong individually -- the LOOP is unbounded structurally. Fixing that belongs in a gate-design plan, not in more C0 polishing rounds.

decision: RESUMED under the shipped convergence policy (plan 2026-06-09-002 merged to main f325cc1, closed completed 312f98e; C0 branch rebased onto it). Applied the operator's recorded round-6 split exactly: BLOCK/TIGHTEN (conceptual) — (1) F003 now enumerates the tier-1 heuristic language set explicitly (Swift, Kotlin, TypeScript/TSX, JSX, Go, Rust = every detector-marker language without a tier-2 parser) with a guarantee that a detected tier-1 language with import-like statements always yields heuristic edges (never filesystem-only) and per-language fixture pins; (2) F004 pins NON-CODE SATISFACTION RULES for manifest/build/test/config/infra/doc/adr (covered at tier 0 declared/medium when detected + node present; not_found when undetected; never missing_extractor in C0; scan_truncated demotes to partial like filesystem). TIGHTEN/EDIT (quick) — (3) F003 purity clause at parity with F001/F002 (no network/mutation/cache, tested); (4) F005 empty_repo wording de-conflated (empty repo asserts only repo-root node + limited + EMPTY per-language map; language assertions live in their own fixture cases); (5) F004 scope guard extended to the no-new-parser-extractors non-goal (guard test pins the tier-2 extractor set unchanged). NEXT: one re-lock; any further medium-only matrix tail gets per-finding DISPOSITION via `dontpanic plan disposition` instead of a paid spiral — the policy this plan's pause produced.
rationale: Operator-sequenced return: convergence rule first, then C0 under it.

decision: First C0 lock under the LIVE convergence policy: refusal correctly named branch d_first_round (the rounds ledger began with this audit — C0's six historical rounds predate F001). 3 blocking findings, fixed in text: (1 CRITICAL parity) my D014 enumeration created a real JS/TS contradiction — RESOLVED by pinning the tier-2 parser set EXACTLY as today's (Python .py + plain JavaScript .js/.mjs/.cjs) with TypeScript/TSX/JSX explicitly tier-1 never-parser-covered, renaming F005's 'JS/TS' fixture to 'JavaScript' and adding a TS-heuristic-low assertion inside it (ground truth: architecture_contract.py _EXT_TO_KIND); (2 MED) per-language map domain pinned — exactly the detected languages, undetected OMITTED never not_found (status reserved/unused in the per-language domain in C0, tested), empty repo -> empty map; (3 MED) unknown-language fallback note pinned — source files outside the marker table yield a generic 'Language dependency extraction was not attempted for unrecognized file types.' note in the final payload, with an unknown-language fixture. Critical present -> plan-fix path, not disposition. Next round has ledger history: a medium-only eligible tail will fire operator_disposition_required and be dispositioned per the operator's standing instruction.
rationale: The critical was mine to fix (introduced in D014); the two mediums ride along since the input fingerprint changes anyway.
